title: Postman vs Insomnia vs Bruno
description: Runnable companion for the Postman vs Insomnia vs Bruno decision guide: a Bruno checkout contract-test collection (create cart, add item, checkout, refund) runnable with bru run, the equivalent Postman collection, a staging environment and a GitHub Actions workflow.
descriptionEs: Companion ejecutable de la guía Postman vs Insomnia vs Bruno: colección Bruno de tests de contrato de checkout (crear carrito, agregar ítem, checkout, reembolso) lista para bru run, la colección Postman equivalente, un entorno staging y un workflow de GitHub Actions.
author: Mathias Paulenko
